attributes.calibration: The census was CALIBRATED against the live corpus before its number was quoted, per the run-39 hard rule. Two defects were found and fixed by that calibration, and BOTH are the same defect the class's own population_note predicted: (1) screening the PRE-swap relocation sets in the transposed pass hid game/ui/btext::FontInit outright -- our ADDR16_LO sits at word index 10 and the target's at 11, so at fixed offsets both words read as RELOCATED and the site vanished; a permutation moves each relocation WITH its atom, so the sets must be permuted too. (2) passing `relocation_types=None` into `prove_zero_result` makes the known-zero dataflow distrust every relocated word and refuse sites the shipped rules prove; apply_patch always builds that map and a census that omits it under-reports. Only after both fixes does the census return the two known positives. A census that had shipped before calibration would have reported ZERO members of a class with TWO shipped members -- i.e. it would have measured its own blindness and published it as a fact about the image.
attributes.measurement: Run 41, at commit 7300fe688 + the two rules this lane landed. 575 count-symmetric functions with a non-empty residual scanned image-wide from the RAW pre-WebFrank bodies; 78 skips, all `auto_*` data/bss/rodata splits and no code (the skip list is printed, because a census that swallows errors reports a false all-clear).

falsifier: Any count-symmetric function holding a differing word pair where (a) OUR word is outside `decode_copy_form` but inside `decode_zero_form_destination`, (b) the two words' destinations agree after at most one adjacent transposition, and (c) `prove_zero_result` discharges BOTH words -- and which is not already pinned. `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wz_zeroform_demand.py` prints exactly that set from the current tree and re-derives this number in one command; a non-empty UNSERVED row falsifies the count. The wider claim (that a family-label census cannot be screened) is falsified by any site whose correct class can be named from the family label alone without decoding the two words.

THE SHIPPED LIVE-ZERO VALUE CLASS (`equivalent_zero_form`, proof `zero_value_dataflow`) HAS ZERO UNSERVED CUSTOMERS IMAGE-WIDE, AND THE TWO CUSTOMERS BANKED FOR IT WERE CUSTOMERS OF THE OLDER COPY-FORM MODE. Measured run 41 over 575 count-symmetric functions with a residual: exactly TWO hold a word pair that only this class can serve -- game/ui/btext::DrawStringTextMLines (window [0x1f4,0x1fc) order [1,0], both words write the literal 0 to g27) and game/ui/btext::FontInit (window [0x28,0x30) order [1,0], both write 0 to g30) -- and BOTH are already pinned and closed by that class. The unserved population is 0. The class's lifetime payoff is therefore 2 functions, both banked in run 37, and nothing in the current image would extend it.

THE TWO CUSTOMERS THE RUN-40 CENSUS NAMED FOR IT ARE NOT MEMBERS. claim.NM_close-lane-candidate-census-and-the-two-live-zero-customers-run-40.20260902.v1 banked game/sfx/psfx::LoadPdataFile and game/pb/pb_diag::pbDiagDrawMenu as equivalent_zero_form customers; both closed BYTE-EXACT this run with NO webfrank.py change, through `equivalent_copy_form` composed with `instruction_permutation` and `copy_register_fields`. LoadPdataFile's +0x118 pair is ours `li r29,0` against the target's `addi r28,r23,0` (constant load vs register copy, destinations differing) -- `constant_dataflow_recolor`, shipped run 30. pbDiagDrawMenu's +0x118 pair is ours `li r25,0` against `addi r25,r26,0` (destinations already AGREEING) -- plain `dominating_def`, shipped earlier still. Neither word is outside `decode_copy_form`, which is the only thing the zero class exists to reach.

CONSEQUENCE, and it is the second independent confirmation of claim.law.WF_live-zero-family-straddles-the-copy-form-boundary-and-only-half-of-it-needed-a-new-class.20260902.v1 rather than a new idea: a demand census stated in FAMILY terms is not merely imprecise, it is systematically wrong in one direction. Run 37 measured half its family-labelled demand already served by a six-run-old mode; run 41 measured ALL of its family-labelled demand already served the same way. The screen that decides the class is three lines and no build -- decode both words, ask whether OURS is a copy form, and ask whether the destinations agree -- and it must be run before a capability is named in any work order, brief, or park record's `capability_needed`. The corollary for the capability-census policy in AGENTS.md is sharper than 'count the payoff': a payoff count taken against the wrong class name counts real functions into the wrong column, which is how a shipped class acquires phantom demand two runs running.

WHAT THE CLASS STILL EARNS: nothing further, and that is not an argument to remove it. Its two members are closed, its guards are exercised by tests, and the boundary it draws (the literal zero only, destinations must agree, no composition with a register stage) is what makes the copy-form/zero-form split decidable at all. The maintenance question it raises -- a guard surface with no remaining customer -- is for the integrator, not for a lane to settle unilaterally.
